usage.callShape: POST https://stableenrich.dev/api/whitepages/property-search with JSON body {street, city, state_code}
usage.outputShape: body.result.property_address (full_address, county, zip), body.result.ownership_info.business_owners[].name / person_owners[], body.result.residents[].{name, phones[].number, phones[].type, emails[].email, current_addresses[]}
quirks: Property search uses field name `state_code` (two-letter code), NOT `state` — `state` is silently ignored.
Sibling endpoint /api/whitepages/person-search takes {first_name,last_name,state_code?} or phone/address to find people.
Result is nested under body.result (single object), not an array.
Returns PII (phones + emails) of residents at the address — handle responsibly.
usage.guide: POST to https://stableenrich.dev/api/whitepages/property-search with JSON body {street, city, state_code} (state_code is the two-letter code, not full state name). Pays x402 ~$0.44 USDC on Base, returns synchronously. Read the result at body.result: property_address for the location, ownership_info for owners (business_owners[] / person_owners[]), and residents[] for people at the address with their phones[].number and emails[].email. For person lookups instead, use the sibling /api/whitepages/person-search endpoint.
